report:
Initial-stage diagnosis: SS hydration is independently repeated by two credited retailer accounts, A04 and A08, under different conditions: pre-makeup use and use alongside tretinoin/other actives. Their shared support is reported hydration, not independently repeated proof of every benefit or an isolated SS effect. A09 separately reports hydration retention from Avant Guard plus SS; allocation between mask and serum is inseparable. No opposing hydration experience is visible in the available text, but A07's body is unavailable, so the check is incomplete.

Texture evidence is conditional: A04 describes SS as lightweight, refreshing and fast-drying without a clogged-pore feeling; A03 finds it stickier than Wave Serum while continuing SS use for its believed higher glycerin content. These observations do not establish a uniformly nonsticky product, nor are comparative stickiness and fast drying necessarily contradictory. A03's independence posture is unavailable. No precise texture proposition receives independent recurrence or cross-venue corroboration here.

Behavior: A04 explicitly ordered SS after introduction by a sister, then bought Buffer Jelly seeking greater nighttime hydration/repair, followed by face wash and mesh moisturizer. The account does not isolate hydration as the cause of every purchase; refill metadata does not establish an additional repurchase. A03 retains SS despite comparative stickiness. A09 deducts a star for mask fit, especially at the nose on a very small head; no return or remedy is narrated. No focal account explicitly reports abandonment or completed repurchase.

Other-product limits: A04's Buffer Jelly glow, face-wash cleansing/hydration and breakout report, and moisturizer acquisition do not corroborate SS performance. A10 reports Buffer Jelly retaining unspecified hydrating products overnight and morning glow; SS is not named. Context-only hillary_____k (Reddit t1_m7j6ppe, 2025-01-16) reports buying Regimen Lab Level Serum during Black Friday, brighter/more even skin, and emphatic repurchase intention—not completed repurchase. Its score is 24; it provides no SS testimony. The parent post concerns Regimen Lab discovery, not SS experience.

Engagement: A03 has native score 6, explicitly marked material_positive=false and not interpreted. Every focal Junip review has 0 up-votes and 0 down-votes, with observation time unavailable. Context score observation time is also unavailable. These metrics establish neither independent experiences nor prevalence, buying effects or material resonance. Product metadata resolves references only; review updates are not additional observations or events. Formula versions are unknown throughout. A07 is requested because 'undefined...' cannot support any experience finding. No subsequent-stage evidence has yet been supplied; counts below reflect available initial-stage testimony.
